data.name: [GK-027][P1][O270][W08] Convert bespoke agreements and manual orders to payment
data.desc:
## Context

Owner: Agent; Kind: Implementation
Priority: P1 — required launch outcome.
Order: 270; Wave: 8; Parallel group: none.
Requirements: C03, C04, C05, C12, A07; Design/contract revision: planning r5, K02 K04.
Agent execution: gpt-6-astra/high, fresh worker and separate fresh reviewer.
Inputs: brief/input-revision, Creator r2, ADRs/contracts r5+, features/screens, prerequisite evidence, SETUP/DELIVERY.
Execution check at start/resume: skills/gk-plan/references/execution-check.md; model requested/effective, history, hashes, checked readback pending.
Depends on: GK-021, GK-022, GK-023, GK-024, GK-025, GK-016, GK-018, GK-012, GK-005; deliverable: accepted policy/setup/tested outputs; bootstrap B2.
Unblocks: GK-029, GK-030.
Safe in parallel with: none.
Conflicts: shared contracts/schema/router/migrations; master coordinates.
Readiness: Blocked on customer policy, Instagram ownership and approved customer/chef designs.

Save custom draft/reference/changes, provide copy summary plus open @gk.cake flow; no auto DM. Chef records versioned quote/customer proof and agreed snapshots, customer approves exact quote before payment. Manual order uses same resource/collection operations; external paid provenance explicit, no invented provider capture.

Rules: server-owned price/capacity/state; GBP pence, UTC/Europe/London; role+ownership; expected_version+Idempotency-Key; unknown stays pending; no network under DB locks.

POST /api/v1/custom-requests: paired source fields below, servings/date/changes and approved contact; returns request_id/version/source pair/summary, handoff_state:not_sent. Reorders return current choices, never pay. Manager /admin/orders links one agreed quote version and uses normal resource/payment commands.

Checkout takes quote_id/version, slot, policy consent/contact and key; returns202 operation_id/pending/poll3s. Atomically create order+all resource/discount holds+collection job. Signed inbox deduplicates account/environment/event; verify amount/currency. Unknown retains holds; confirmed-unpaid releases; terminal late capture creates full-return recovery, never reopens order.

Proposed: API10s/DB2s/provider5s; retries1m/5m/15m/1h then manager, alert15m. Validate; retain unknown funds.

Manual quote defaults to hosted full payment. Approved offline payment needs manager, unique evidence/source/reference/time; unresolved online collection blocks it. Offline refund needs obligation+actual-return evidence, never provider POST.

No sent self-report; approved allergen disclosure required to buy. GK-019/provider gates identity; sign-out does not revoke JWTs.

C12 wire: catalog image {image_revision_id,url,alt,width,height}; draft create/GET stores inspiration_id + image_revision_id. Both absent/null = generic; half-pair422 INVALID_REFERENCE_PAIR. Versioned PATCH changes/clears both atomically; omitted pair unchanged. Reject client object keys/arbitrary URLs.
Summary key+{expected_version,image_revision_id:UUID|null} must match draft (else409 STALE_VERSION); generic null pins nothing. Server resolves immutable key/version/metadata and verifies same inspiration, published-ready image and active public source or authorized retained request. Foreign/private/archived-before-first-freeze/missing/tombstoned selection ->409 REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE, no disclosure/substitute.
Freeze atomically saves summary/differences and image revision/key/version/MIME/dimensions/alt with a pin. Pin/cleanup lock the same reference row; tombstone rejects new pins; replacement/archive cannot delete/alter pinned bytes. Quote keeps exact summary/image provenance. GET /custom-requests/{id}/revisions/{revision}/image: owner/capability or active associated manager, foreign404, refreshable short-lived URL+metadata. Text handoff contains reference, no secret; customer/chef retrieve the same image.
GK-005 approves retention/deletion duration. Only explicit approved request/quote deletion atomically releases pins when every retained link permits; never incidental catalog cleanup.
AC1–AC3 image fixtures: view A then replace B before draft/freeze -> A or unavailable/reselect, never B. Freeze A then replace/archive/cleanup -> owner/associated manager retain exact A/quote provenance, foreign/public archived404. Pin/cleanup race -> retained A or unavailable without broken reference. Cover null/half-pair/foreign selection and approved deletion.

## To dos

T1. Red: smallest AC1–AC3 fixture assertion; infrastructure failure is not red.
T2. Implement data/API/UI/recovery with snapshots/auth/idempotency (AC1–AC3).
T3. Integrate migrations/consumers/audit/notices; verify real DB/provider failures (AC1–AC3).
T4. Green -> refactor -> rerun affected checks; record revision/results (AC4).
T5. Complete AC4 review/delivery/acceptance evidence; no implied deployment.

## Not to dos

No unrelated cleanup, registrations, leaked secrets or releases/deployments without authority. No app execution now; Done needs Creator acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1. Red retry converts one quote version at most once; expired/changed quote and lost capacity return revalidation without duplicate order/payment.
AC2. Clipboard/Instagram unavailable retains selectable summary and same request reference; mobile/desktop account-device check records actual handoff with no DM-sent claim.
AC3. Reorder from history/gallery resolves current variants/price/allergens/availability; archived source offers request; chef cannot bypass capacity or attach order to guessed customer.
AC4. Record exact input/tested revision, results, independent review and Creator acceptance on Trello; account for all related PRs, required review/checks, native auto-merges and main CI. Release/deploy/smoke only when separately authorized and in scope.

Test prerequisite: verified GK-020 B2 runners before Ready. Planned: go test ./..., go test -race ./..., go test -tags=integration ./... with disposable PostgreSQL; UI: npm run check, npm test, npm run build + approved browser runner. Use controlled provider sandbox/recipients and real IDs, not mocked proof. Planning ran no app tests.

Publication snapshot of the independently reviewed planning packet. Trello is the live execution record; application work has not started.
